title: draba nivalis var. denudata
intro: Draba nivalis var. denudata, commonly known as Naked Whitlowgrass, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antibacterial activity. The bioactive constituents of Draba nivalis var. denudata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
